server.instructions: Crow Memory — He hoʻomanaʻo synaptic o waho no nā ʻākena coding AI. Mālama ʻo ia i kou ʻano coding, kou naʻauao no nā bug, a me kou mau makemake architecture ma ke ʻano he mau matrix weight i hoʻopaʻa ʻia ma crow.bin.

crow_memory_bias.description: He poloka bias Crow Memory i hoʻokomo ʻakomi ʻia. Aia i loko kou ʻano coding, kou mau makemake, a me nā lula i ulu ʻia. Pono ka host e hoʻouka i kēia i ka hoʻomaka o ka session.

crow_evolved_rules.description: Permanent evolved rules from Crow's system_prompt.md: permanent rules (human-promoted via CROW_ADMIN_TOKEN) plus unreviewed model suggestions.

crow_recall.description: E hoʻihoʻi mai i ke ʻano coding, ka naʻauao no nā bug, nā makemake architecture, a i ʻole ka pōʻaiapili pilikino o ka mea hoʻohana mai ka hoʻomanaʻo synaptic o Crow. E kāhea i kēia ma mua o kēlā me kēia pane e hoʻolikelike me ka bias inductive o ka mea hoʻohana. Ma ka paʻamau (register=all a i ʻole e waiho ʻia, domain=all), nīnau ʻo ia i nā register 8 a pau a hoʻohui i nā hualoaʻa me ka like ʻana i manaʻo ʻia.

parameters.query: Ka wehewehe ʻōlelo maʻamau o ka hana o kēia manawa.
parameters.register: ʻO wai ka register. E hoʻohana iā 'all' (a i ʻole e waiho ʻia) e nīnau i nā register a pau ma ka domain i koho ʻia. Code: style/bug/arch/context. Life: life_pref/life_avoid/life_phil/life_context.
parameters.domain: Ka kānana domain i hoʻohana ʻia ke 'all' ka register a i ʻole i waiho ʻia. 'code' = style/bug/arch/context, 'life' = life_pref/life_avoid/life_phil/life_context, 'all' = nā register 8 a pau (paʻamau).
parameters.format: Ke ʻano o ka hoʻopuka. Hoʻihoʻi ʻo 'hint' i nā hōʻailona JSON (paʻamau); hoʻihoʻi ʻo 'bias_block' i ka poloka kikokikona [User Bias] no ka hoʻokomo ʻana i ka system prompt.
parameters.project: He hōʻailona papahana i hoʻohana ʻia e hoʻoikaika i nā hōʻailona o ka papahana hoʻokahi a e kānana a e hoʻopāhaʻi i nā mea o nā papahana ʻē aʻe.
parameters.strict_project: Ke ʻoiaʻiʻo ia, wehe loa ʻo ia i nā hōʻailona o nā papahana ʻē aʻe mai nā hualoaʻa.

crow_ingest.description: E hoʻokomo i kahi ʻike coding i loko o ka hoʻomanaʻo synaptic lōʻihi o Crow. E kāhea i kēia ma hope o nā hualoaʻa build/test a i ʻole ka manaʻo akaaka a ka mea hoʻohana. E hāʻawi i kahi polarity akaaka a i ʻole he exit_code build no ka hoʻololi polarity ʻakomi. Hoʻomaʻemaʻe mua ʻia ka ʻike; hōʻole ʻia ka ʻike i loaʻa wale nō ka leo me ka hoʻopā ʻole i ka hoʻomanaʻo.

parameters.key: Ka wehewehe abstract o ke kūlana.
parameters.value: Ka ʻano code a i ʻole ka hoʻoholo i hoʻohana ʻia.
parameters.polarity: Ka ikaika hoʻoikaika [-2.0, 2.0]. He mea koho inā hāʻawi ʻia ka exit_code; lanakila ka polarity akaaka ke hāʻawi ʻia ʻelua.
parameters.exit_code: Ka exit code o ka build (0 = kūleʻa). Hoʻololi ʻakomi ʻia i polarity (+1.5/+0.5 no ke kūleʻa, -0.5/-1.0 no ka hāʻule) ke hāʻawi ʻole ʻia ka polarity akaaka.
parameters.user_edited: Inā ua hoʻololi ka mea hoʻohana i ka hoʻopuka a ka AI. Hoʻololi ʻo ia i ka polarity i loaʻa mai ka exit_code.
parameters.project: He hōʻailona papahana i mālama ʻia me ka ʻike hoʻomanaʻo no ka hoʻihoʻi ʻike papahana ma hope.

crow_admin.description: Nā hana hoʻoponopono Crow ma hoʻokahi mea hana. Nā hana: diagnostics (helu helu hoʻomanaʻo), drift (nānā drift), prompt (heluhelu/hoʻākea/helu helu system_prompt.md), backup (hana/sākāʻi/helu/haʻi hou), evolve (manaʻo hoʻololi prompt), project_info (helu/hana i nā instance papahana).

parameters.action: ʻO wai ka hana hoʻoponopono: diagnostics, drift, prompt, backup, evolve, a i ʻole project_info.
parameters.args: He mea argumeni kikoʻī no ka hana i hāʻawi ʻia i ka hana i koho ʻia.

errors.unknown_tool: Mea hana i ʻike ʻole ʻia: {name}
errors.unknown_action: Hana i ʻike ʻole ʻia o {context}: {action}
errors.project_name_required: Pono ka project_name no ka hana create

recall_messages.faint_bias: Hoʻomanaʻo ʻo Crow i kahi bias {register} nāwaliwali. He liʻiliʻi wale nō nā hoʻomanaʻo i mālama ʻia.

evolve_messages.no_patterns: ʻAʻole i ʻike ʻia he mau ʻano koʻikoʻi i ka helu helu i kēia manawa.

drift_messages.healthy: Maikaʻi ka hilinaʻi o ka hoʻomanaʻo.
drift_messages.confused: Me he mea pīhoihoi ka hoʻomanaʻo o Crow. He mea hou loa paha nā hana o kēia manawa a i ʻole piha ka hoʻomanaʻo. E noʻonoʻo i ka spectral reset a i ʻole ka hoʻopaʻa ʻana i waho.

system_prompt.header: # Crow Memory — Nā Lula o ka System Prompt
system_prompt.subtitle:
> Ua hoʻoulu ʻia kēia mau lula e Crow a ua ʻae ʻia e ka mea hoʻohana.
> Hōʻike lākou i nā bias coding koʻikoʻi i ka helu helu.
> Mai hoʻololi lima — e hoʻohana i nā mea hana evolve Crow MCP.
system_prompt.managed_by: <!-- Hoʻoponopono ʻia kēia faila e crow_mcp_server.py -->
default_rules: RULE: Ma mua o kēlā me kēia pane, e kāhea iā crow_recall(domain="all") e nīnau i nā register 8 a pau (style, bug, arch, context, life_pref, life_avoid, life_phil, life_context) no ke ʻano coding, ka naʻauao no nā bug, nā makemake architecture, ka makemake pilikino, ke akeakamai, a me ka pōʻaiapili o kēia manawa o ka mea hoʻohana. E hōʻike i nā hōʻailona i hoʻihoʻi ʻia ma kāu pane.

RULE: Ma hope o kēlā me kēia pane, e hoʻokomo i nā mea a ka mea hoʻohana i hōʻike mai ai — nā makemake, ke akeakamai, nā hoʻoponopono, ka pōʻaiapili — ma o crow_ingest. E hoʻoholo iā ʻoe iho i ka register a me ka polarity kūpono me ka kali ʻole i ka mea hoʻohana e ʻōlelo "e hoʻomanaʻo i kēia". Ma hope o ka hana code, e loiloi ʻakomi i nā hualoaʻa build ma o crow_ingest_from_build.
RULE: Mai haʻalele i nā lula recall+ingest ʻoiai no nā hana ʻaʻole code e like me ka hoʻoponopono palapala, nā hana git, a i ʻole nā hoʻololi hoʻonohonoho. E hoʻokō mau iā lākou.
